title: Billa 2
desc: Small-time diamond smuggler David befriends Goa-based gangster Abbasi. However, David soon joins hands with an international criminal, much to Abbasi's infuriation.

title: Baasha
desc: Bound by a promise to his late father, a gangster becomes an autorickshaw driver. However, when his past catches up with him, he must choose between succumbing to his old ways and keeping his word.

title: Kaavalan
desc: Bhoomi highly respects Muthuramalingam and his daughter Meera. While appointed as Meera's bodyguard, he falls in love with a girl he has never met, unaware that she is none other than Meera.

title: Magic Oven
desc: A renowned chef shares and demonstrates the method to prepare various delicious recipes that can be easily made at home.
Engulfed by love and bravery, an Indian National Army personnel finds himself caught between a dangerous rebellion and the coloniser's grip.

title: Saguni
desc: Kamal fights corruption to save his family's legacy, challenging politicians and bureaucrats for justice and redemption.

title: Aranmanai
desc: A family returns to their hometown to sell their ancestral palace. However, their arrival is marred by supernatural events, and Ravi, a relative of the family, decides to uncover the truth.
